title: More clarity across FullWorth
summary: A focused update to make bills, transactions, connections and account actions easier to understand and safer to use.

highlights.title: Clearer bill and transaction totals
highlights.description: Bills and Overview now distinguish comparable bill changes from missing history. Transactions show posted outflows separately by currency, without mixing refunds or pending charges.

highlights.title: Find and review your bills faster
highlights.description: Search, sort, and filter Bills without changing loaded totals. The Missing a bill? panel explains discovery evidence; failed refreshes preserve prior bill data with a warning.

highlights.title: Activity that stays useful during errors
highlights.description: Search activity and review linked evidence independently of marking an alert read or dismissing it. Failed refreshes no longer imply there are no alerts.

highlights.title: Safer account and privacy actions
highlights.description: Disconnect and archive states are clearer. Ended connections can be archived or restored to the list without reconnecting; uncertain privacy requests never claim success prematurely.

highlights.title: Save drafts without guessing
highlights.description: Planning and personal setup preserve edits when save responses are uncertain, with read-only verification before another attempt. Your bank balances and payment history are not rewritten.

highlights.title: Better phone usability and reliability
highlights.description: Mobile navigation adapts to larger text, provider logos fall back gracefully, and background parser HTTPS certificates renew before expiry.
